description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange Effective from 19.10.2020 to 25.10.2020
reasoning: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification (General) issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It concerns the determination of official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges. This falls squarely under the definition of "Regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "Statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation" in the Legal/Regulatory category (Type 5), as it is a regulatory action based on an existing legal ordinance.
